# Review competitor collaboration and information exchange

[Overview](#overview) · [Before you start](#before-you-start) · [Steps](#steps-at-a-glance)

## Overview

A counsel-reviewed proceed, modify or decline decision with approved information boundaries and monitored implementation.

Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.

## Step details

<a id="step-1"></a>

### 1. Describe the collaboration and information flows

agent-runnable


Record the participants, markets, purpose, proposed agreement, meetings and information to be exchanged. Identify pricing, customers, output, bids and other sensitive subjects for counsel; use private materials without contacting competitors or circulating new information.

- Sources: [Your Europe competition rules](https://europa.eu/youreurope/business/selling-in-eu/competition-between-businesses/competition-rules-eu/index_en.htm)

<a id="step-2"></a>

### 2. Obtain competition-law assessment before exchange

human · human approval every run · hard to undo


Qualified competition counsel assesses the actual parties, markets, restrictions and applicable jurisdictional rules. Escalate sensitive exchanges and proposed coordination before participation; this guide supplies no exemption, safe-harbor threshold or automatic clearance.

- Sources: [Your Europe competition rules](https://europa.eu/youreurope/business/selling-in-eu/competition-between-businesses/competition-rules-eu/index_en.htm)

<a id="step-3"></a>

### 3. Prepare the counsel-directed controls

agent-runnable


Prepare the proposed agenda, permitted information categories, access restrictions and recordkeeping under counsel instructions. Identify prohibited topics and stop or escalation routes; any clean-team arrangement needs counsel approval for this specific matter.

- Sources: [Your Europe competition rules](https://europa.eu/youreurope/business/selling-in-eu/competition-between-businesses/competition-rules-eu/index_en.htm)

<a id="step-4"></a>

### 4. Approve, modify or decline the proposal

human · human approval every run · hard to undo


The accountable legal and business owners record the counsel-reviewed decision and precise conditions. If declined, skip agreement and exchange. A commercial manager or agent cannot replace competition review with a general confidentiality agreement.

- Sources: [Your Europe competition rules](https://europa.eu/youreurope/business/selling-in-eu/competition-between-businesses/competition-rules-eu/index_en.htm)
- If "Counsel-reviewed decision approves the collaboration and information controls": continue at step 5
- If "Proposal declined; skip agreement and information exchange": continue at step 6

<a id="step-5"></a>

### 5. Implement only the approved collaboration

human · human approval every run · hard to undo


*Follows step 4 (when Counsel-reviewed decision approves the collaboration and information controls).*

When: Only when the counsel-reviewed decision approves this collaboration.

Authorized participants use the approved agreement, meeting agenda and information controls. Keep a record of recipients and shared materials, stop an exchange that crosses its boundaries, and refer changes or unexpected sensitive discussions to counsel.

- Sources: [Your Europe competition rules](https://europa.eu/youreurope/business/selling-in-eu/competition-between-businesses/competition-rules-eu/index_en.htm)

<a id="step-6"></a>

### 6. Review compliance and retain the decision trail

agent-runnable


*Follows step 4 (when Proposal declined; skip agreement and information exchange) or step 5.*

Reconcile actual participants, shared information and activities against the approved limits. Assign breaches and changes to counsel, retain decision and meeting records, and close declined proposals without executing an agreement or exchanging the proposed information.

- Verify: A counsel-reviewed proceed, modify or decline decision with approved information boundaries and monitored implementation.
- Sources: [Your Europe competition rules](https://europa.eu/youreurope/business/selling-in-eu/competition-between-businesses/competition-rules-eu/index_en.htm)
